text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
First place goes to Admire Vega! Admire
Vega is
our Derby champion!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(The cheering... the thunderous noise is
almost
numbing.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(I feel like I'm floating. I feel hot... It's
making it
hard to stand.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(This heat... It's coming from my heart!
My heart's
on fire!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I kept Top Road from catching up.

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
How did it feel to gather every last
ounce of your
strength and dash down
what seems like an
endless final stretch?

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
How did it feel to be showered with
cheers and
applause?

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Mother
text_block_list.text:
Did you take it all in and live in the
moment?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Aaaaagh! I can't believe this! Talk about

frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
This just makes me want to beat you
even more.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep training during summer camp.
I'll focus on
stamina as much as I can!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: This time, at the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I meet Admire Vega in the prep room
after the
race.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Opera O was there... and Top Road too.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: でも、君が勝つって信じてたから
でも、貴方が勝つって信じてたから
choice_data_list_en: Still, I always believed you would win.
Still, it's because I believed you'd win.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
choice_data_list: 君の末脚を、強さを、信じてたから！
貴方の末脚を、強さを、信じてたから！
choice_data_list_en: Because I believed in your late kick—in your strength!
Because I believed in your late kickâand your strength!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She quickly goes off to prepare for the
winning
concert. As I watch her, I feel
reinvigorated.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Kikuka Sho, the final race of
the Classic
Triple Crown, coming next,
I'll do everything I can
to make sure she
excels again!
